candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s) on every checkout trace, causing order to return 502 and gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502 at ~2s; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~2406ms, consistent with payment read timeouts.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs or dependency operation series; cannot confirm whether payment is slow, saturated, or unreachable.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent payment ReadTimeout errors propagating to order 502 and gateway checkout 502, while inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics confirm elevated checkout latency and 502s. Bounded to downstream payment latency; payment-side evidence is missing.
